summary: A wall of data sources for a screen across a room. Each tile is one source: its name under a quiet caption, its status as a word with a dot, one large figure with its unit, a line of detail, its freshness, and its readings over time faint along the foot. The status colors the tile's edge and a glow under it: good while up, warning while degraded, critical and slowly pulsing while down, no color and a hollow dot while unknown. The wall fills each row with as many tiles as fit and wraps, never scrolling sideways.

anatomy.wall: A grid of tiles, 12 apart: as many equal columns as fit with no tile narrower than the wall's tile size (160, 224 or 288), one column where the room is narrower than that; the tiles of a row are as tall as the tallest. A group named by label.
anatomy.tile: A column, 8 apart, on card with an edge, rounded by radius-surface, padded 12, in card-foreground. With onSelect or href the whole tile is one control under its pieces.
anatomy.edge: Known statuses: the tile's edge is the status color mixed 45 percent into border, and a rule 2 thick in the status color runs along the top inside the edge. Unknown: a dashed border-strong edge and no rule.
anatomy.glow: Known statuses: a wash 64 tall from the tile's top, the status color at 10 percent (up) or 18 percent (degraded, down) fading down to nothing. While down it breathes with the live pulse. None while unknown.
anatomy.head: The caption, text.xs in muted-foreground, cut to one line, with the flag at the line's end, 8 apart; under it, 2 below, the icon (16) and the name, text.label, 6 apart, the name cut to one line.
anatomy.caption: The tile's caption at the head's top: text.xs in muted-foreground, cut to one line.
anatomy.name: The source's name under the caption, beside its icon: text.label, cut to one line.
anatomy.flag: With flag: an outline chip (parts/chip) at the end of the caption's line, such as Simulated.
anatomy.status: A dot 10 across in the status color and the status's word, text.label in the status's ink, 6 apart. Unknown: the dot hollow, edged in faint. Down: the dot breathes with the live pulse.
anatomy.figure: With value or unit: the value at text.statistic in tabular figures, cut to one line, and its unit at text.sm in muted-foreground, on one baseline, 6 apart.
anatomy.value: The figure's value: text.statistic in tabular figures, cut to one line.
anatomy.unit: The figure's unit after its value, on one baseline: text.sm in muted-foreground.
anatomy.detail: With detail: one line at text.help in muted-foreground, cut with an ellipsis.
anatomy.foot: With updatedAt: the freshness (parts/freshness) at the end of a line pushed to the tile's foot.
anatomy.series: With series: the readings as a line across the tile's whole width, 32 tall, flush with its foot and sides: values spaced evenly, the lowest at the foot and the highest at the top, the line 1.5 thick in the status color at 70 percent over an area in it at 12 percent. Equal values, or one, are a level line through the middle.

label.does: The wall: what it shows, for a screen reader.

tile.does: The wall: the narrowest a tile gets, 160, 224 or 288.

status.does: The tile: how the source is doing.

caption.does: The tile: a quiet line over the name, such as the source's kind.

icon.does: The tile: drawn before the name.

value.does: The tile's one figure, such as its latency.

detail.does: The tile: one line under the figure, such as why it is degraded.

series.does: The tile: readings over time, oldest first, drawn along its foot.

seriesLabel.does: What the series shows, for a screen reader; without it the series is decoration.

flag.does: The tile: a small chip at the head's end, such as Simulated.

updatedAt.does: The tile: when the source was last heard from, in milliseconds since the epoch, or none for never; the freshness is drawn only with it.

now.does: The moment the freshness counts from; without it, the shared clock.

onSelect.does: Makes the whole tile one button.

href.does: Makes the whole tile one link.

tileSm.note: The narrowest a tile gets at tile sm.

topRule.note: The rule in the status color along the tile's top.

down.means: The source does not answer: critical, its dot and glow breathing.

unknown.means: Not known yet: no color, a dashed edge and a hollow dot.

hover.means: The pointer over a tile that is a control: washed.
hover.reached: pointer over, with onSelect or href

selected.means: The tile chosen: edged and ringed in primary.

focus.means: Keyboard focus on the tile: the focus outline around it.

unknown.note: Dashed, with no rule and no glow.

rest.note: None while unknown; fades to nothing 64 down.

down.note: The dot breathes with the live pulse.

unknown.note: The dot hollow, edged in faint.

rest.note: The line at 70 percent of the status color, the area under it at 12 percent.

keyboard.does: Reaches each tile that is a control, in the wall's order.

keyboard.when: a tile with onSelect has focus

sokkel-ui: StatusWall and StatusTile, both from @winterop-com/sokkel-ui/StatusWall; the status type is WallStatus.
With onSelect or href a button or link covers the tile under its pieces, a button saying aria-pressed for selected.
The status color reaches the edge, the rule, the glow and the series as the tile's --wall-tone.
The pulse is the animate-live utility, stilled where motion is reduced or turned off.
